package.name: moz1_sim_isaac
package.description: Isaac Sim 5.1.0 side of the Moz1 sim integration. Paste-into-Script-Editor OmniGraph attach scripts that make the Spirit AI Moz1 simulation present the SAME ROS2 contract as the real robot's embedded controller + Livox driver (the controller at 172.16.0.20 is the DDS publisher; MovaX is a TCP operator console, not a ROS node): /livox/lidar, /livox/imu, /joint_states, /odom, /tf (sim -> stack) and /cmd_vel, /joint_command (stack -> sim). These scripts run inside the Isaac Sim Python (omni.*), not on the ROS2 host; they are installed to share/ for reference.
